options.vulkanimprovement.meshTerrainRen: Draws the mesh-shader terrain path for diagnostics while vanilla terrain remains visible unless Cancel Vanilla Terrain is enabled.
options.vulkanimprovement.terrainCapture: Mirrors vanilla terrain into VIM GPU data without replacing visible terrain. Heavy diagnostic mode. Mesh Terrain already captures terrain.
options.vulkanimprovement.meshTranslucen: Captures translucent terrain metadata for diagnostics. Visible water and translucency remain vanilla until ordering and effects match vanilla. Requires Mesh Terrain or Capture Bootstrap.
options.vulkanimprovement.meshletFrustum: Enables shader-side meshlet frustum culling. Requires Mesh Terrain, with GPU Task Commands off or Full Captured Terrain on. Leave off while checking for edge-of-screen chunk holes.
options.vulkanimprovement.strictMeshTerr: Experimental validation mode that lets mesh terrain cancel vanilla solid and cutout draws. Keep off until visible coverage is proven. Requires Mesh Terrain.
options.vulkanimprovement.drawAllCapture: Draws all captured solid and cutout mesh terrain instead of the visible-list subset. Requires Mesh Terrain. Heavy diagnostic mode.
options.vulkanimprovement.vanillaChunkVi: Applies vanilla chunk-section fade to mesh terrain. Requires Mesh Terrain.
options.vulkanimprovement.terrainFragmen: Applies Vulkan fragment shading rate to terrain. Requires Mesh Terrain and GPU support.
Requested Vulkan fragment shading-rate tile size for terrain. The renderer clamps this to device limits. Requires Terrain VRS.
With VSync on, keeps Minecraft from running more than a frame ahead of the screen, using Vulkan present id and present wait. Requires VSync and a device that supports them.
options.vulkanimprovement.waitIdleBefore: Waits for the Vulkan device to idle before terrain uploads. Heavy validation mode. Requires Mesh Terrain or Capture Bootstrap.
options.vulkanimprovement.allowCpuVisibl: Allows the legacy CPU visible-meshlet-list fallback when work-queue upload is unavailable. Requires Mesh Terrain, with Full Captured Terrain off.
options.vulkanimprovement.gpuGeneratedMe: Uses experimental GPU-generated mesh-task indirect commands. Off by default until async synchronization is validated. Requires Mesh Terrain, with Full Captured Terrain off.
options.vulkanimprovement.gpuDrivenTerra: The GPU draws the opaque terrain of every section in view from its own page table. Off lists each frame's pages from the CPU instead. Requires Cancel Vanilla Terrain, with Full Captured Terrain off.
options.vulkanimprovement.cullMeshlets.t: The task stage drops meshlets that face away from the camera or are out of view before their vertices are read. Requires Mesh Terrain with GPU Task Commands or GPU-Driven Terrain, and Full Captured Terrain off.
options.vulkanimprovement.taskStagePageC: Listed pages go straight to the task stage, which drops what is out of view. Off culls and compacts them in a GPU pass first. Requires Mesh Terrain and GPU Task Commands, with Full Captured Terrain off.
options.vulkanimprovement.terrainGpuTime: Measures the GPU time of the mod's prepared work and of each group of terrain layers. Diagnostic; it costs some frame rate. Requires GPU timestamps.
options.vulkanimprovement.dumpCapabiliti: Logs Vulkan Improvement capability and runtime-profile JSON when the Vulkan device is captured.
options.vulkanimprovement.requireVulkanB: Forbids OpenGL fallback after Vulkan backend creation fails or is not selected. Debug/development option.
options.vulkanimprovement.acceleratedWor: Enables diagnostics for an optional accelerated worldgen provider. Does not change renderer or worldgen authority yet. Requires an installed provider.
options.vulkanimprovement.validationDesc: Validation mode that disables the descriptor-heap requirement. Applies to Vulkan device selection.
options.vulkanimprovement.initialSection: Initial GPU section-storage capacity for captured terrain. Requires Mesh Terrain or Capture Bootstrap.
options.vulkanimprovement.initialMeshlet: Initial GPU meshlet-storage capacity for captured terrain. Requires Mesh Terrain or Capture Bootstrap.
options.vulkanimprovement.initialVertexP: Initial GPU terrain vertex-payload buffer size. Requires Mesh Terrain or Capture Bootstrap.
options.vulkanimprovement.initialIndexPa: Initial GPU terrain index-payload buffer size. Requires Mesh Terrain or Capture Bootstrap.
options.vulkanimprovement.terrainMirrorS: Delay before mirrored terrain is treated as stable after capture churn. Requires Mesh Terrain or Capture Bootstrap.
